title: AI-Powered Personal Finance App
summary: A full-stack mobile app that tracks finances, teaches money literacy with an AI assistant, and connects users through a social feed.
problem: Many people struggle to manage their finances and lack accessible, personalized financial education. This thesis project explores how AI and social features can make personal finance guidance practical and engaging.
built: Built the full-stack app end to end: Flutter mobile UI, Firebase backend (auth, database, hosting), expense tracking, an AI-powered virtual literacy assistant, and a social platform where users can share progress and tips.
learned: Integrating the AI assistant and third-party APIs was the hardest part — handling async calls, error states, and keeping the UI responsive when data was slow or unavailable taught me a lot about resilient app design.
